pairs.l: 2 — doesn't use their PC at home?
3 — tries to control how much time they spend on their PC?
4 — says they don't need so many meetings now?
5 — uses their PC instead of the telephone?
6 — uses their PC to find out what's happening in the world?
8 — makes and receives payments on their PC?
9 — uses their PC in the workplace more than they used to?
10 — says their PC saves them space?
11 — says someone criticises how long they spend on their PC?
12 — doesn't give information about themselves over the internet?

r1.exp: 1=B (Alex: 'look at teaching forums, pick up useful practical tips'). 2=D (Sue: 'we have a rule that I don't turn it on inside the flat'). 3=E (Jade: 'limiting myself to just a couple of hours a day'). 4=F (Mohammed: 'I've been sending work to my tutor by e-mail... we don't have to see each other so often'). 5=A (Vanessa: 'making calls over the internet, much cheaper than landlines'). 6=C (Pete: 'I like to read the news sites'). 7=D (Sue: 'I can use it while I'm commuting'). 8=A (Vanessa: 'internet banking'). 9=B (Alex: 'I find myself using it increasingly in the classroom'). 10=F (Mohammed: 'just imagine how much room it would take up if it was all on paper'). 11=C (Pete: 'My partner says I should restrict how long I'm online'). 12=E (Jade: 'it's advisable to never reveal any details about yourself').

r13.exp: 'What initially came to mind was that maybe it OCCUPIES TOO MANY HOURS of the school timetable' = zauzima previše vremena = D.

r14.exp: 'Last but ONE out of twelve' = predzadnje od 12 = 11. mjesto = C (Eleventh).

r15.exp: 'Did the experience DAMAGE us mentally?... they appear to have grown up WITHOUT any LASTING EFFECTS' = gubitak ne mora štetiti djeci = C.

r16.exp: 'Learning how to MANAGE BOTH SUCCESS AND FAILURE is a vital lesson' = nositi se sa životnim razočaranjima = B.

r17.exp: 'Everything is relative... 19th out of 80... much BETTER THAN EXPECTED... I look back with PRIDE' = gubitak ne znači nužno neuspjeh = B.

r18.exp: 'Activities like aerobics or Pilates are NOT bad... any kind of exercise IS A GOOD THING' = mogu imati pozitivnih učinaka = A.

r19.exp: 'Make sure you understand the assignment. (19)___. It's much easier to ask the teacher.' → B: Don't be afraid to clarify what's expected. Razjasni što se od tebe očekuje.

r20.exp: 'Most energy and focus when you begin. (20)___. Later, more tired → simpler things.' → F: So it's best to use this mental power on the most challenging subjects.

r21.exp: 'Sit too long → lose concentration. (21)___. Take 15-min break every hour.' → H: As a result, you will become less productive than if you stop every so often.

r22.exp: 'If stuck, don't obsess. (22)___. But don't pick someone you'll chat with all night.' → C: Instead, ask an adult or older sibling for help or call a classmate for advice.

r23.exp: 'Work harder and harder as they fall further behind. (23)___. Ask for help before it's too late.' → A: Naturally, this can make them hate a class and everything to do with it.

r24.exp: 'Help from another student... hearing from a peer's perspective. (24)___. Lots of people understand without being able to explain.' → E: However, this might not get you the results you need.

r25.exp: 'RECEIVED a degree' — 'receive a degree' je standardna akademska kolokacija (dobiti/primiti diplomu).

r26.exp: 'Test pilot FOR the National Aeronautics Advisory Committee' — prijedlog 'for' za organizaciju za koju netko radi.

r27.exp: 'WAS selected by NASA in 1962' — past simple passive za konkretnu prošlu godinu.

r28.exp: 'Gemini 8 mission, WHICH completed the first joining' — ne-restriktivna relativna surečenica uz zarez → 'which' (ne 'that').

r29.exp: 'The greatest media event IN the world' — prijedlog 'in' u superlativnoj konstrukciji (the greatest... in the world).

r30.exp: 'With scarcely A pause' — neodređeni član 'a' uz jedninsku imenicu. 'Scarcely a pause' = jedva ikakva pauza.

r31.exp: 'DESPITE planning and rehearsal, he had made a mistake' — 'despite' + imenička skupina (bez 'of'). 'In spite of' bi tražilo 'of'.

r32.exp: 'Has KEPT a low profile' — fiksna kolokacija: keep a low profile = biti u sjeni, izbjegavati javnost.

r33.exp: 'Doesn't look like a detective AT ALL' — fiksni izraz: not... at all = uopće ne.

r34.exp: 'Succeeds WHERE they have failed' — relativna priložna zamjenica 'where' = ondje gdje (u situacijama u kojima).

r35.exp: 'INSTEAD of looking for clues' — 'instead of' = umjesto (+ gerund).

r36.exp: 'THERE is a great deal of wickedness' — egzistencijalna konstrukcija: there is/are.

r37.exp: 'MADE her first appearance' — fiksna kolokacija: make an appearance = pojaviti se.

r38.exp: 'Compete WITH Hercule Poirot' — fiksna kolokacija: compete with sb (natjecati se s nekim).

r39.exp: 'She WOULD soon become one of her most famous creations' — 'would' za buduću radnju gledanu iz prošlosti (future in the past).

r40.exp: 'Wrote in 1940. HOWEVER, not published until 1976.' — 'however' za kontrast između dviju rečenica.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA globalizaciju: lakša komunikacija, dijeljenje znanja, gospodarski razvoj. PROTIV: nestanak lokalnih tradicija, kulturna homogenizacija, dominacija engleskog/zapadnih vrijednosti. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
